gloss: always; habitually; on a daily basis

definitions.gloss: always; habitually; on a daily basis; at all times
definitions.explanation: Describes something done regularly as a matter of course, or a habitual state of affairs. Somewhat formal.

examples.japanese: {常日頃|つねひごろ}{思|おも}っていること。
{常日頃|つねひごろ}から{体|からだ}を{鍛|きた}えている。
examples.english: I train my body on a regular basis.

examples.japanese: {常日頃|つねひごろ}{感|かん}じていた{不満|ふまん}をようやく{上司|じょうし}に{伝|つた}えた。
examples.english: I finally told my boss about the dissatisfaction I had always felt.

notes:
Means "always, habitually, on a regular basis." Emphasizes that something is a constant, ongoing state or habit. Somewhat formal in tone.

FORMATION:
{常|つね} (always, constant) + {日頃|ひごろ} (usually, daily life). More emphatic than {日頃|ひごろ} alone.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {常日頃|つねひごろ}から: from one's usual daily life, always
- {常日頃|つねひごろ}{思|おも}っている: something one always thinks
- {常日頃|つねひごろ}の{行|おこな}い: one's usual conduct

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {日頃|ひごろ}: usually, normally (less emphatic)
- {普段|ふだん}: ordinarily, normally (casual)
- {常|つね}に: always, constantly (more literary)
